name: Willowbrook
summary: Willowbrook is a premier regional shopping destination in Wayne, New Jersey, featuring over 170 stores and restaurants ranging from designer fashion brands to popular retailers and diverse dining options. The center offers a comprehensive shopping experience with a modern movie theater, seasonal events, and convenient seven-day operations.
demographics: Willowbrook attracts a diverse, middle to upper-middle income demographic from the affluent Wayne and Passaic County areas of northern New Jersey. The primary trade area includes families with household incomes ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+, with a strong representation of professionals aged 25-54 who seek both convenience and quality. The center draws suburban households looking for a comprehensive shopping experience that combines designer brands with everyday retailers, and the location serves as a regional destination for shoppers from surrounding communities seeking upscale fashion, technology, and dining options in a convenient mall setting.
description: Willowbrook stands as one of northern New Jersey's premier shopping destinations, offering an exceptional retail experience in Wayne with over 170 stores and restaurants. This expansive regional mall seamlessly blends high-end designer fashion brands with popular mainstream retailers, complemented by cutting-edge technology suppliers and diverse dining options. The center features a modern Cinemark theater with XD and ScreenX technology, providing entertainment beyond shopping. Willowbrook has established itself as a community gathering place, hosting seasonal events like Easter Bunny photo opportunities and serving as a year-round destination for families and fashion enthusiasts alike. With convenient seven-day-a-week operations and extended hours on Fridays and Saturdays, the mall caters to busy professionals and weekend shoppers, while its prime location in Wayne makes it easily accessible to residents throughout Passaic County and beyond.
